note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a OMA 15; A06b OMA 15; L05 OMA 5, OMA 19): ordinary naturalisation after 20 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Oman, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Oman for at least 20 years. ... Written consent and proof of renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person has acquired a foreign citizenship without prior permission of the authorities.
